reuse.why: Builds one predicate (isMonthFillTarget) and one selection (getMonthFillCategories) used by all month-wide actions, reuses getBudgetData, getSheetValue 'sum-amount-' cells and setNMonthAvg; the template check parses goal_def itself rather than through goal-template code.

duplication.why: Removes the per-action hidden SQL and income guards and the repeated sign flip (spendingToBudgetAmount); the only overlap left is the category/group/notes join written both in getBudgetData and in getMonthFillCategories.

placement.why: The selection rule, its flags and the sign helper live in budget/actions.ts next to the actions; app.ts only registers the new method.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the month-wide actions, their selection, the new method's registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: A single predicate now decides inclusion with the hidden-scope inconsistency named explicitly ('visible' vs 'not-hidden'); two positional parameters on every call and filtering in JS over the full category list are minor costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending) decides its categories through isMonthFillTarget.

disguised_duplication.where: The flag-loading join is restated in getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories, but openly, not reshaped to hide it; the decision logic itself is shared.

abstraction_drift.where: budget/actions.ts isMonthFillTarget/getMonthFillCategories take scope ('visible'|'not-hidden', an explicit preserved inconsistency) and includeHiddenCategories (the requested option), each with one branch; templates and #fixed went in as general rules and no action bypasses the helper.
